[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/21074/diffs?diff_id=1472552615&start_sha=1e37b953e619d51163ea011d5e18f0d77bdb8cf8)

The "initialize release-4.4" 03fa047c74a53b02e3a96da32451eee8a91ad302 had changes switching the "build our Linux packages" jobs from 2x-daily (as done on master to avoid eating all the CI minutes due to the frequent merges) to when merged. Do we want that on 4.6 as well?
We do, not only to save CI minutes but to generate the display filter reference after each merge.
